changelog:
urlmitra-link-manager v1.0.0

- Initial release introducing URLMitra integration for link management.
- Supports branded shortlink creation, redirect health audits, and click performance analytics.
- Enables semantic search across workspace resources via natural language queries.
- Requires URLMITRA_API_KEY and standard command-line tooling (curl, jq).
summary: Manage branded redirects, audit traffic analytics, and execute semantic link queries using URLMitra.
